parent.rule: Spot replication is independent corroboration and cannot rewrite the parent.

mechanism: Exact-rule cross-instrument replication of target-day weekday structure in one-day-ahead realized variance.

exact_carryover.realized_variance: sum squared 5m close-to-close log returns on UTC day; accepted day >=270 returns
exact_carryover.HAR_DOW: same HAR plus target-day Tue-Sun dummies, Monday base
exact_carryover.estimation: rolling previous 730 valid feature rows; minimum 500; daily re-estimation

gates: Identical to parent BTC/ETH futures MVE.

interpretation.if_survives: Supports instrument/market robustness of the intraweek volatility-forecast mechanism.
interpretation.if_fails: Futures result remains valid but may not generalize to spot.
